thread:
maria_c: FYI customer (ACME) opened an escalation — TS SDK streaming on Edge workers intermittently drops the final chunk after a reconnect and were seeing duplicate token billing spikes. Attaching logs and a minimal repro below.

maria_c: Logs show a 401 mid-stream (token rotation) then a reconnect that resumes the stream. After resume the client sometimes never emits the final \"[DONE]\"/final event, and the tokens for the resumed segment appear billed twice.

--- logs snippet ---
[2026-03-15T16:02:12.341Z] stream.start id=stream-7e2f client=acme-edge-v1
[2026-03-15T16:02:20.512Z] auth.rotate reason=short-lived-token id=stream-7e2f status=401
[2026-03-15T16:02:20.613Z] stream.reconnect id=stream-7e2f new_session=sess-920
[2026-03-15T16:02:21.102Z] token.count delta=+392 billed customer_tokens=812
[2026-03-15T16:02:21.705Z] stream.end id=stream-7e2f reason=client-closed missing_final_frame=true
--- end ---

maria_c: Minimal repro (TypeScript, Edge runtime):
```ts
const ac = new RedwoodEdgeClient({token: shortLived});
const ctl = new AbortController();
const it = ac.responses.stream({model: 'x', stream: true, signal: ctl.signal});
for await (const chunk of it) {
  console.log(chunk.text);
  if (someCondition) ctl.abort(); // triggers reconnect in app logic
}
```

maria_c: Customer says this only started after they upgraded to @redwood/stream-sdk v1.5.0; on v1.4.2 they didn't hit it.

devon_eng: Can you confirm if the customer uses our browser polyfill or a native EventSource? Edge runtime often uses fetch stream + AbortController. Any differences between Node vs Edge?

maria_c: Theyre on Cloudflare Workers (Edge) using the TS SDK with our fetch-based implementation. Node envs appear fine.

alex_platform: Quick hypothesis: in v1.5.0 we changed resume semantics to try to auto-resume on 401; Edge AbortController + worker fetch streaming sometimes causes the final chunk to be swallowed when the SDK spawns a new request. That could produce no final frame and duplicate token accounting when the resumed segment is billed separately.

alex_platform: Can you attach a full HAR or our stream session debug logs? Also want the exact SDK release and if they set any resume/config flags.

maria_c: Pasted session debug and SDK version: v1.5.0. No custom resume flags used. Customer did not set a request_id header.

ops_jay: Billing note: duplicate token spikes can occur if resume is implemented as a new request without de-duplication. We should ensure server-side resume delta accounting is idempotent by session id + seq range. Adding a server-side guard would fix billing, but client should also avoid re-sending already-billed chunks.

caroline_support: Can we reproduce locally on a CF Worker with a short-lived token rotation stub? If so we can validate whether the final chunk is lost or merely not forwarded to application code. Also we need repro to escalate to eng-runtime.

devon_eng: I can spin up a CF Worker harness and run the exact steps. If I can reproduce, I'll attach a tiny test harness and open an ENG issue with steps and suspected regression diff (v1.4.2 -> v1.5.0).

alex_platform: Short-term mitigation for the customer: 1) pin SDK to v1.4.2, or 2) disable auto-resume (if they can tolerate a client reconnect flow) or 3) use longer-lived tokens for streaming sessions. We'll also provide a script to reconcile duplicated billing entries while we investigate.

maria_c: Customer accepted pinning to v1.4.2 for now. They asked for an ETA on a fix and whether a server-side billing rollback is possible.

ops_jay: We'll open a billing investigation ticket to review duplicate charges; if we confirm double-billing we'll credit back. Need stream session IDs and timestamps (provided above).

devon_eng: Repro plan: create CF Worker harness that simulates 401 mid-stream at ~8s, then let SDK auto-resume. If final chunk missing -> capture traces and minimal failing test. If not reproducible, try toggling AbortController timing and resume backoff.

caroline_support: I'll create the support escalation doc and tag eng-runtime + billing. Please add any further logs to the thread.

deploy-bot: Deployed patch candidate branch \"fix/stream-resume-edge-guard\" to staging for internal repro runs.

maria_c: Thanks — updating ACME. Will follow up once devon confirms repro or we have a runtime fix. :thumbsup:
